tests_added: NotFoundPage renders a theme toggle button in its header
NotFoundPage still renders the 404 heading and the back button
deviations: Wrapped <ThemeToggle /> in a <div style={{ alignSelf: 'center' }}> because the header uses alignItems: 'baseline', which would otherwise push the 34px pill toggle to the text baseline. This keeps it visually aligned with the title without altering the left title block. Minimal and within scope.
